title: Capital House, Lewisham
address: Capital House, Lewisham, London SE6 4AS, England, United Kingdom
description:
Flexible offices to grow your business at Capital House, Lewisham, London SE6 4AS.

Education:
Capital House has been a key provider of educational space for a number of years hosting many educational institutions. From academies & nurseries to colleges & tuition centres, we continue to work with education providers in updating our spaces to meet the ever growing needs to keep this market growing and working efficiently. Flexible spaces with classrooms, partitions & options for courtyard & play areas can be constructed. We work with our clients to ensure they are provided with up-to-date areas working with feedback to continuously improve and assist if possible. One of our most prestigious education at Capital House is a private Family Learning School, located on the second floor with its own private courtyard area.

Places of Worship / Religious Groups:
Capital House has been home to many who have been seeking private and safe spaces in which to carry out their Worship. Whatever your needs, such as staging set-ups or seating arrangements can be accommodated. We invite you to visit to view the range of spaces that may be suitable for your religious group. We offer spaces to help with your needs such as male and female changing areas and separate Pastor’s offices. With flexibility you are able to take on more space as you grow.

Business Centre:
At Capital House we have developed hubs for office space users in order for them to thrive in a professional environment and all the relevant features. From small units to larger spaces, Directors’ offices and staff areas can be constructed as well as ready to go spaces with furnishing available. Boardrooms, training rooms & kitchenette areas are some of the great things our clients in the building utilise the most. Our large welcoming reception has multiple seating and reading space for guests on arrival. We offer ad hoc rooms for meetings on half-day/full-day rates and seminar areas with whiteboards and tea/coffee services.

Artist Studios:
Dedicated creative hubs for creative personnel to home in on their craft. With great lighting coming in from large windows, open spaces give the artist a chance to come in and put their vision forward in an inspiring atmosphere to work and network in.

Retail Units:
Prominent main road premises between Catford and Lewisham stations with buses stopping outside and an ALDI store opposite. Units up to 6,000 ft² (557 m²) fitted out with modern floor, walls, ceiling, changing rooms, toilets, loading bay and included rear car parking. Low starting rent.

Ground Floor (Main Hall):
A ground floor area of 4,300 ft² (400 m²) with dedicated street access in a prominent block between Catford and Lewisham stations, with several side rooms and toilets. Low starting rent.

Garage / Workshop:
A 600 ft² (55 m²) garage accessible through the car park, fitted with part-mezzanine, front roller shutter, electricity and water. Parking in front of garage is available—ideal for craft work, set-up work, or storage.

Check out the walkthrough video tours of Capital House:

• https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jJNft38k7lo

title: Mulberry Way
address: Mulberry Way, Belvedere Industrial Estate, Greater London DA17 6AN
description:
Mulberry Way Warehouse / Storage / Workshop / Church.

Suitable for various industrial/warehouse uses with on-site parking and open storage land.

Size:
460 m² to 5,600 m² (5,000 ft² to 60,000 ft²), with a possibility to split into smaller Units of 185 m² (2,000 ft²).

Rent & Terms:
Rents from £7,500 per calendar month plus service charge. All units are available on a new lease on flexible terms.

Property Overview:
The property comprises inter-connecting warehouse units and two-storey offices in a fenced secure yard. Features a large high bay with 7m eaves height. All services are available, except Gas. The units are let on an “as-seen” basis. Incoming Tenants to carry out their own survey and make arrangements as required.

Location:
Belvedere is located 5 miles from junction 1A of M25 north of London Borough of Bexley. This is an established industrial estate with other reputable occupiers including Ocado, Tesco, Lidl. Comprising large industrial units with separate office area and land suitable for open storage or Lorry Park.

Business Rates:
London Borough of Bexley – TBC. Interested parties should make their own enquiries via the Local authority on 020 8303 7777. Hanif Properties cannot guarantee any figures.

Reference Charge:
A fee of £200 will be charged for taking up references for proposed tenants. This fee is non-refundable after references have been taken up, whether accepted or not by the Landlord.

Holding Deposit:
Tenants wishing to secure this property will be required to pay a holding deposit of £3,000. This deposit is not refundable except if the landlord withdraws, clear title cannot be proved, or the Tenant’s references are not acceptable to the Landlord.

Or email: info@hanifproperties.com

title: Epping Commercial Complex
address: High Road, Epping, Essex CM16 5HW, United Kingdom
description:
Epping Commercial Complex - Units to Let on High Road, Epping CM16 5HW with large car parking facilities.

Epping Commercial Complex is a prominent roadside premises on the Epping High Road, Epping, Essex, providing a versatile mix of office, showroom, workshop and storage accommodation with significant central car parking for about 40 cars. Centrally located for up-market areas of Epping, Loughton, Romford and Waltham Abbey.

Transport Links:
Easy access to M11 and M25 junctions (6 miles) providing connections to the M25 in the south and Stansted Airport and Cambridge to the north. Romford/Dagenham 12 miles. Local businesses include Miller and Carter, Shell, Epping Golf Club and Epping Forest tourist area.

Units & Land Available:
• Units available from 2,000 sq ft to 9,000 sq ft
• Land on main road from 2,000 sq ft to 13,000 sq ft
• The complex includes a 22-room American style motel and the famous Auction House attracting lots of visitors.
• 4 plots of land facing the main Epping High Road and a restaurant.
• Central car parking area for about 40 cars.

Main Building Suitable For:
• Banqueting & Events
• Corporate Head Offices
• Commercial Kitchens / Restaurant
• Gym & Fitness Centre
• Showroom & Storage
• Retail or Online Trade

Land Suitable For:
• Vehicle & Car Storage
• Airport Parking & Services (Stansted 20 miles)
• Premium Car Wash (Jet or Hand Wash)
• Children's Play Area
• Farm Shop & Flower Centre

Accommodation:
The property could be separated (subject to planning) to form numerous retail units, offices, leisure facilities, etc.

Terms:
The property is available to let by way of a sublease on full repairing and insuring (FRI) terms. Rent is negotiable according to area and facilities required. A holding deposit of 1 month’s rent is required to secure the property while the legal process is completed (non-refundable, adjusted against quarterly rent). Quarterly rent in advance and quarter rent deposit.

Business Rates:
The property has a rateable value of £29,100. Interested parties should contact Kettering Borough Council on 01536 410333.

Services:
Mains water, gas and electricity connected to the property. All services are untested by the landlord.

Planning:
The unit is believed to benefit from Auction House, Motel and Restaurant use. Interested parties should verify with the local authority.

Legal Costs:
Tenant to cover all legal costs, including a £1,500 undertaking to cover landlord’s abortive legal fees if the tenant withdraws.
